name: How do ceramic, natural stone, and glass backsplash tiles compare?

mainEntity.name: How do ceramic, natural stone, and glass backsplash tiles compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceramic and porcelain tiles are durable, stain-resistant, and cost-effective, but they require periodic grout maintenance. Natural stone such as marble, slate, or travertine delivers a high-end, organic look, though it is porous and requires regular sealing to prevent oil and moisture stains. Glass tile reflects light and creates an open feel, yet it requires specialized mortar and expert cutting to prevent chipping. Consider your cooking habits: heavy-use cooktop areas benefit most from low-porosity materials like porcelain or solid slabs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ceramic is budget-friendly and durable; natural stone offers luxury but needs regular sealing; glass adds modern brightness but requires specialized cutting.
